projects.title: 3D Printed Portable PC
projects.summary: A refined take on the 3D Printed Portable PC.

versions.note: This is a new case design for a powerful, compact rig that has a small removable tray on the right for cables, dongles, controllers, etc.
Added holes for USB ports, power button and ventilation for the GPU
Added ventilation for the CPU cooler
Added magnet holes for the cover and chamfers to ensure it will work on an FDM printer
Moved the back wall 3mm due to interference with the motherboard IO shield
Increased the thickness of the PCIE holder since it was too thin to be printed
Added a chamfer to the PCIE finger for DFAM
Moved the GPU power connector cutout to relieve potential strain on cable
Added holes for magnets to secure the cover to the Case_Base
Model for the top fan filters. A cutout is made for the handle. Magnet holes as well. A small, 1mm wide, 0.6mm cutout is placed around the border to improve the visual seam
Added magnet holes for the top fan filter. Also added 13x13mm magnet cutouts for the removable side cover. Added 45 degree pegs to secure the bottom half of said side cover
Added a 1mm wide, 0.6mm deep cutout to improve the seams of the design.

Iterating from my previous designs, this version goes back to Air cooling and is focused more on ease of use and consistency. The IO is in a more traditional orientation as opposed to the vertical layout of before. It also adds front USB ports to make it easier to add/remove peripherals. A removable right section is added to store cables/peripherals during transport.
